## Background 
This repository purpose is to reproduce figure 3 from Schaefer et al. (2000), that demonstrated the changes in stream chemistry overtime including hurricane disturbance by Huricane Hugo. The analysis focus on concentration changes in (a) potassium, (b) nitrate-N, (c) magnesium, (d) calcium and (e) ammonium-N in Bisley bason and Rio Mameyes Punete Roto.

## Data
Raw data was downloaded from the Environmental Data Initiative. https://doi.org/10.6073/pasta/f31349bebdc304f758718f4798d25458. 
  
  McDowell, W. and International Institute of Tropical Forestry(IITF), USDA Forest Service.. 2024. Chemistry of stream water from the Luquillo Mountains ver 4923064.

## Methods
1_Cleaned_data was developed by applying moving-average() and tidy-data() functions. The tidy_data function filters all the data from 1988-1994 and selects the ions needed for analysis. The moving-average function applies 
9 week moving average and calulates the mean average for every site.

Sites are combined into one data frame to develop a csv found in ouput/. With the ouput data you will pivot longer to collapse all ions into one column to facit by ion. 


## Results

```{r}
#| warning: false

# load package
library(tidyverse)

# Read csv created with components needed for analysis
final_data <- read_csv("../output/figure3_data.csv")

# Plot years on the x-axis and ion concentration on the y-axis
ggplot(
  data = final_data,
  mapping = aes(
    x = window_start,
    y = Concentration,
    color = site,
    linetype = site
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Ion, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Hurricane effects on stream chemistry",
    x = "Years",
  )
```
